summary: Full E2E test of new AdminMensagensTecnicosPage feature (backend + frontend). All 10 review scenarios verified successfully: sidebar entry with unread badge, page load, thread list, conversation view (admin right/yellow, tech left/grey), send reply, mark-as-read on open, tech->admin propagation, and permission gating via ProtectedRoute module='funcionarios'. Screenshot confirms clean two-column UI with correct data-testids.
critical_code_review_comments: Sidebar unread badge polls every 30s (useUnreadAdminMessages) — after admin opens a thread the badge still shows the old count until next poll (up to 30s). Consider triggering an immediate re-fetch or exposing a manual refresh from AdminMensagensTecnicosPage after fetchMessages() marks-as-read. Minor UX polish.
AdminMensagensTecnicosPage uses fixed height h-[calc(100vh-220px)] which may clip on short viewports/mobile; acceptable for desktop admin use.
useUnreadAdminMessages hook uses catch{} silently — fine, but if backend endpoint is broken there is no visible signal.
seed_data_creation: Added 2 chat messages (tech->admin 'E2E test iteration 21 - tech->admin' + admin reply 'E2E reply from admin iteration 21') plus one backend curl round-trip. All harmless test data in daniel oliveira's thread.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Feature Mensagens Técnicos is live at /mensagens-tecnicos with data-testids: admin-tech-messages-page, thread-{empId}, conversation-list, admin-msg-{id}, admin-chat-input, admin-chat-send, nav-mensagens-tecnicos, sidebar-unread-badge. Backend endpoints under /api/tech/admin/messages/* work correctly (threads aggregate, GET marks read, POST reply).
